refnamediv.refpurpose: Modifies a DateTime object, with added amount of days, months, years, hours, minutes and seconds

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.errors;
If the object or interval has not been correctly initialized (for example, by a class extending DateTime or DateInterval without calling the parent constructor), a DateObjectError is thrown.

&reftitle.notes;
When the addition crosses a transition of the time zone, such as the end of daylight saving time, the result depends on where interval comes from: an interval created from an ISO 8601 string adds the elapsed time in wall clock units, while an interval returned by DateTime::diff is added in civil units. The same nominal interval can therefore give results one hour apart.
